Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment notification for the Project Assistant-I position has been released by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) for their research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Assistant-I post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Project Assistant-I position is 02-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.C.A., B.Sc., B.A., B.Com., B.B.A., LLB., or an equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline to be eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Project Assistant-I post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Assistant-I position will receive a monthly salary ranging between ₹28,000/- and ₹53,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this recruitment exclusively through online mode by visiting the official recruitment portal of IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on a selection test or an interview conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee details have been specified in the official recruitment notification released by IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this opening?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant-I position is temporary in nature and is associated with a sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: You can apply online by visiting the official IIT Gandhinagar project staff recruitment website through the direct apply link provided in the important links section.
